paragraphs.text: Fumulus , also known as the Infestation , is a vampire insect from an unknown plane.

Fumulus is a character who debuted in Foundations Jumpstart as part of the Black Icky deck . It has an appearance similar to a large flying Hercules beetle surrounded by numerous other smaller versions of it. Its back glows red, likely to represent its vampire nature. Fumulus groups together Insects, Leeches , Slugs and Worms as an infestation typal coupling .

It is potentially from Zendikar due to the plane having similar blood sucking insects who are sometimes commanded by vampires. Further, what appears to be a Hedron partially submerged beneath swamp muck is visible in the background of its art.
